name: Celebrating Halloween
overview: Scripture calls believers to reject the practices and abominations of the surrounding nations, emphasizing a life transformed by the renewing of the mind and true worship in spirit and truth. Christians are urged to avoid conformity with worldly customs that contradict God's will, instead cleaving to what is good and abhorring evil. This foundation guides the believer in discerning whether participating in celebrations like Halloween aligns with honoring God and overcoming evil with good, while also training children in godly ways that endure.
